infoCards.bodyText: An initiative by Stimuli IQ for meritorious and needy healthcare aspirants across the world.
Don't let financial setbacks hold you back from a successful healthcare career.

heading.title: Built for every healthcare career aspirant
heading.subtitle: One scholarship, every program — here is what it gives you.

items.title: Completely merit and need based
items.description: Awards are decided on academic merit and financial need, nothing else.

items.title: Up to 50% fee waiver
items.description: No repayment, no service obligation. The waiver applies directly to your program fee.

items.title: Covers every Stimuli IQ program
items.description: Psychology, Clinical & Counselling Psychology, Neurology, Healthcare Training, and Internship tracks are all eligible.

items.title: Open to students across India
items.description: MBBS, BDS, BSc Nursing, Psychology, Life Sciences, Allied Health, and related degree students from any college or university can apply.

items.title: Extended mentor access
items.description: Scholars get additional 1:1 sessions with clinician mentors and personalised career guidance throughout the program.

data.heading: Application form
data.subheading: Leave your details and our scholarship team will call you within 24 hours to check your eligibility.

leadForm.heading: Apply for the scholarship
leadForm.subheading: Takes less than two minutes, and you need no documents to start.

heading.title: Scholarship Application Process
heading.subtitle: Five steps from application to certified professional.

items.title: Check your eligibility
items.description: Fill the short application form below. It takes less than two minutes.

items.title: Submit your details
items.description: Tell us your qualification, the program you want to join, and your financial background.

items.title: Receive your scholarship award
items.description: Applications are reviewed competitively and successful applicants are notified within days.

items.title: Enrol and prepare
items.description: Join your program with the fee waiver applied, plus extended sessions with your clinician mentor.

items.title: Complete your internship and get certified
items.description: Finish the program and earn your verifiable certificate.
